english: Haa~...
What's wrong, Tachibana?\nMoping...
Hmph! Just leave her alone, won't you?\nShe's probably just hungry.
Ahaha, I'm just really glad...\nthat I get to fight together with Chris-chan\nand Tsubasa-san again, the three of us...
Wh—! What's got you so happy!\nDon't suddenly say weird stuff!
Fufu, I feel the same.
I-I'm not!\nI could fight just fine alone!
Without Chris-chan and Tsubasa-san\nI'd be lonely and couldn't fight right~!
Ugh... geez! Why are you always like this...\nyou throw me off...
Honestly... even Yukine\nis constantly overwhelmed by Tachibana's energy.
Ahaha.
Shut up! Sheesh...
We're caught up in some weird mess this time...\nand you guys haven't changed one bit...
But some things can't be solved\nby worrying...
So wherever we are,\nwe just do what we can.
That's right, and...
And... what!?
Because I made lots of friends\nhere too!
Everyone... we live in different worlds, but\nthey're all good people!
So... as long as everyone's together,\nI'm not scared!
...Sigh... it's always that with you...
That's Tachibana for you.
Ah, but I haven't seen Miku in so long,\nso I'm a little lonely...
Fufu, then we'd better finish this case quickly\nand go home.
Fine, I'll help out\nthe homesick kid!
Uweeh,\nI-I'm not homesick or anything!
Well, maybe a little... don't tease me, Chris-chan!
Don't care! Hurry up\nor I'm leaving you behind!!
W-w-wait, Chris-chan!!\nTsubasa-san! Let's go!
Yeah, let's go, Tachibana!
(Tachibana... Yukine...)
(That I get to fight alongside them\nlike this now...)
(truly makes me happy)
